alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 1 at 2:58PM PST until November 2 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility lowering to a quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Bakersfield, Buttonwillow - Lost Hills - I5, Caruthers -
San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter, Hanford - Corcoran -
Lemoore, Merced - Madera - Mendota, Southeast San Joaquin Valley,
Visalia - Porterville - Reedley, and West Side of Fresno and Kings
Counties.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 10 AM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
